data.text: In accordance with CBSE guidelines and our commitment to public accountability, The VIDYA School publishes comprehensive annual reports highlighting academic excellence, student accomplishments, infrastructural growth, and community development.

data.title: Statutory Transparency Information
data.message: The annual report presents audited scholastic achievements, board examination metrics, teacher development programs, co-curricular laurels, and corporate partnership outcomes.
